indicator_definition: Recycling rate of municipal waste in urban areas as a percentage of total waste generated. Reflects progress in sustainable urban waste management. Data compiled by Eurostat.
rationale: Sustainable cities need efficient waste management. Increasing recycling in urban areas supports the circular economy. Progress means an increasing urban recycling rate.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled from national waste statistics under the Waste Statistics Regulation. Includes material recycling and composting. Published annually.
